name: Plant Shopping Center
summary: The Plant San Jose is a sizable community shopping center offering a diverse mix of stores, services, and casual dining options. Open daily from 8 AM to 10 PM, this neighborhood destination combines convenient shopping with a welcoming, community-focused atmosphere where locals can shop, dine, and connect.
demographics: The Plant San Jose attracts a diverse, community-focused demographic in the South San Jose area, serving families and young professionals in the surrounding neighborhoods. The trade area includes middle to upper-middle income households with a mix of homeowners and renters typical of the San Jose market. Primary visitors include tech workers, families seeking convenient shopping and dining options, and local residents looking for everyday services and entertainment. The center's casual, community-oriented positioning appeals to shoppers seeking a relaxed, accessible alternative to larger regional malls.
description: The Plant San Jose, located at 1 Curtner Avenue in San Jose, California, is a vibrant community shopping destination where life happens. This sizable complex brings together a diverse mix of stores, services, and casual dining options under the motto "Shop. Chill. Connect." The center has established itself as a neighborhood hub where community and commerce intersect, offering good vibes and great shops in a welcoming environment. Open daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, The Plant provides extended hours for the convenience of busy South Bay residents and visitors. Whether guests are grabbing a bite to eat, hitting their favorite stores, browsing the health and beauty offerings, or simply hanging out with friends, The Plant San Jose creates an energetic atmosphere that encourages both shopping and socializing. With a strong 4.3-star rating from over 5,300 reviews, the center has earned its reputation as a go-to destination for everyday needs and leisure activities in the San Jose community.
